Connect

Heat source

Direct connection to the heat source. Touch publishes weighted house temperature on an interval. Wrong host or templates block delivery.

Generic HTTP uses write and read URL templates with {value}, {host}, {port}, and {entity}. Method is POST (fixed in firmware). Request timeout is 2500 ms (fixed).

s

Asgard uses ESPHome number and climate entities on the configured host. Test read and test push verify reachability before saving.
